question: Which sports player won the bronze medal in the 50m Rifle 3 Position Men's event at the Paris 2024 Olympics, becoming the first Indian to do so?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swapnil Kusale**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
__ 

• **Swapnil Kusale** won the **bronze medal** in the **50m Rifle 3 Position Men's event** at the **Paris 2024 Olympics**, marking a historic achievement as the **first Indian** to secure a medal in this shooting event. 

• The **50m Rifle 3 Position** is a highly technical shooting event where athletes compete in three positions: **kneeling, prone, and standing**, testing both precision and endurance. 

• **Swapnil Kusale's victory** was a result of consistent performance, including high scores across all three positions, showcasing his mastery in rifle shooting. 

• This achievement holds immense significance for **India's Olympic shooting history**, demonstrating the growth of the sport in the country and inspiring future generations of Indian shooters. 

• The medal win also reflects the success of **government-backed sports initiatives** and training programs aimed at nurturing shooting talent in India. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
__ 

• **50m Rifle 3 Position Event:** 
 

• In the **50m Rifle 3 Position event**, shooters fire at a target from a distance of **50 meters** in three positions: kneeling, prone, and standing. 

• Each shooter competes in a total of **120 shots**, divided into 40 shots per position. 

• The event demands a high level of **mental focus, physical stability, and technical precision**. 
 
 

• **India's Shooting Achievements:** 
 

• India has been steadily advancing in shooting sports at the **international level**, with shooters like **Abhinav Bindra** and **Rahi Sarnobat** earning accolades. 

• Abhinav Bindra is India's first individual gold medalist in shooting at the **2008 Beijing Olympics**. 

• Indian shooters regularly perform well in events such as the **ISSF World Cup** and **Asian Games**. 
 
 

• **Swapnil Kusale - Profile:** 
 

• **Swapnil Kusale** is a professional shooter representing India in **rifle shooting** events. 

• He has competed in various **national and international championships**, earning recognition for his consistent performances. 

• His success at the **Paris 2024 Olympics** highlights his dedication to the sport and his ability to perform under pressure. 
 
 

• **Shooting Federations and Support:** 
 

• The **National Rifle Association of India (NRAI)** oversees shooting sports in India, ensuring athletes receive proper training and resources. 

• Government programs like **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** and **Khelo India** provide financial and infrastructural support to athletes. 

• These initiatives have played a crucial role in enhancing India's performance at global shooting events.

• **Key Characteristics of Rifle Shooting:** 
 

• Requires **precise body control** and **steady breathing** to maintain focus and accuracy. 

• Modern rifles are equipped with advanced features like **adjustable stocks** and **sophisticated sights** for enhanced precision. 

• Shooting events are governed by the **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF)**, which sets rules and standards for competitions. 
 
 

• **Olympics and Indian Shooting:** 
 

• India's participation in shooting at the Olympics began in the **20th century**, with notable improvements in recent decades. 

• Indian shooters have earned medals in both **rifle and pistol categories**, showcasing versatility. 

• The success of athletes like **Swapnil Kusale** highlights India's growing dominance in international shooting competitions.
